question: What was measured for leetcode-backend baseline before its Rust port (rust-services plan, phase 0 part one)?
workload: 2026-10-08: leetcode-backend baseline before its Rust port (rust-services plan, phase 0 part one)
method: Transcribed from the cited historical record. Units and precision follow the source.
finding: The dev entry (`babel-register` over the sources) is 1,413 ms and 150 MB idle; it is not what runs, so it is not the baseline. The plan had guessed about 60 MB for the Node runtime; the whole service is 78 MB.

rows: - Tier: measurement, no code changed. The service as production runs it (`node dist/bundle/index.mjs`, the 2.6 MB bundle from `pnpm --filter @app/leetcode-backend run bundle`), required env supplied, the secrets loader stubbed with a no-op `WF_BIN`, only `/health` exercised, x86_64 4-core sandbox, node 22, n=5, medians: cold start to the first `/health` 252 ms (225 to 300); idle RSS 78.2 MB (78.1 to 78.3); RSS after 300 sequential `/health` requests 79.9 MB; `/health` p50 1.07 ms, p99 5.8 ms.

- The dev entry (`babel-register` over the sources) is 1,413 ms and 150 MB idle; it is not what runs, so it is not the baseline. The plan had guessed about 60 MB for the Node runtime; the whole service is 78 MB.
